The '''''Opee Fleer''''' was a decommissioned [[military bongo]] that had been rebuilt to participate in the [[Otoh Gunga Challenge]]. Many [[Racing (disambiguation)|racers]] considered the ''Opee Fleer'' too cumbersome, but what it lacked in maneuverability it made up for in size. Its wide, [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|tribubble]] body made it difficult for other racers to pass it.
